facts: Brazilian steakhouse with rodizio-style meats carved tableside by gaucho chefs.
Has an open kitchen and a gourmet salad bar with Brazilian sides.

name: TGI Fridays
summary: American restaurant.
facts: Located in Concourse D at Miami International Airport.
Part of the TGI Fridays chain

name: Thank You Miami
summary: Restaurant on West Flagler Street, Miami.

name: The Arketekt by Aficionados
summary: Restaurant on Brickell Bay Drive, Miami.
facts: Opened in January 2017 as the first restaurant from the Aficionados wine and spirits boutique.
Culinary direction by chef Jean Paul Desmaison, formerly of La Cofradia in Coral Gables.
Address: 1200 Brickell Bay Drive, Unit 107, Miami

name: The Best Sub Shop
summary: Sandwich restaurant on Southwest 77th Avenue, Miami.
facts: Located in the Suniland area of Kendall.

name: The Capital Grille
summary: Steak restaurant on Brickell Avenue, Miami.
facts: Part of The Capital Grille, whose first restaurant opened in Providence in 1990.
Part of Darden, a Fortune 500 restaurant company.

name: The Cheesecake Factory
summary: American restaurant.
facts: The Cheesecake Factory signed a lease for this Lincoln Road space in 2022.
Part of the Cheesecake Factory chain

name: The Cheesecake Factory
summary: American restaurant on Ponce de Leon Boulevard, Coral Gables.
facts: Stands at the corner of Ponce de Leon Blvd and Andalusia Ave in downtown Coral Gables.
Offers weekend brunch and a happy hour.
Part of the Cheesecake Factory chain
Address: 2418 Ponce de Leon Boulevard, Coral Gables

name: The Cheesecake Factory
summary: American restaurant on North Kendall Drive, Miami.
facts: Located at Dadeland Mall, to the right of the main entrance.
Menu has more than 250 items made from scratch daily.
Part of the Cheesecake Factory chain

name: The Cocinita Miami
summary: Restaurant on Southeast 5th Street, Miami.
facts: The Cocinita Burger uses a 25 g pea protein patty, dairy-free cheese and cocinita sauce.
Burger list also has the Sassy burger and the Goody burger.

name: The Counter
summary: American restaurant.
facts: Located inside Miami International Airport, in the gate D33 area.

name: The Daily Creative Food Co
summary: Sandwich restaurant on Biscayne Boulevard, Miami.
facts: Opened in Edgewater in 2006 under owner Adam Meltzer.
Conceived as a mix of coffee shop, neighborhood diner and sandwich shop.

name: The Frieze Ice Cream Factory
summary: Ice cream shop on North Michigan Avenue, Miami Beach.
facts: The original Frieze shop closed after 38 years in business.
The Frieze reopened after an outcry from customers over its closing.
Address: 1626 North Michigan Avenue, Miami Beach

name: The Grape Ape
summary: Spanish restaurant on Southwest 57th Court.
facts: Its internationally inspired menu is by Miami chef Giorgio Rapicavoli.
Pairs a curated wine program with its food menu.

name: The Halal Shack
summary: Middle Eastern restaurant on Stanford Drive, Coral Gables.
facts: A University of Miami campus location of The Halal Shack chain.

name: The Henry
summary: American restaurant on South Miami Avenue, Miami.
facts: Modern American restaurant with a coffee bar, in Brickell City Centre.

name: The Original Crab House
summary: Restaurant.
facts: Menu lists lobster bisque, fried whole snapper and shrimp fettuccine.
Specializes in Maryland-style steamed blue crabs and garlic crabs.

name: The River Oyster Bar
summary: Seafood restaurant on Southeast 7th Street, Miami.
facts: Chef David Bracha is behind The River Seafood & Oyster Bar.

name: Tin Tin
summary: Local restaurant on Southwest 8th Street.
facts: Blends Cuban flavors with French and Italian influences.
Is the sister restaurant to Tinta y Cafe.

name: tinta y cafe
summary: Café.
facts: Named a Bib Gourmand in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide USA.

name: Toni’s sushis
summary: Japanese restaurant on Washington Avenue, Miami Beach.
facts: Opened in 1987 as the first Japanese restaurant in Miami Beach.
Owned and operated by the Takarada family.

name: Truluck's Ocean's Finest Seafood and Crab
summary: Restaurant on Brickell Avenue, Miami.
facts: Harvests its own Florida stone crab from a fishery off Naples.
The Miami Brickell location opened in 2010.

name: UDON
summary: Japanese restaurant.
facts: Opened at Dadeland Mall in October 2025 as a full-service restaurant and cocktail bar.
UDON Asian Food is a restaurant brand that originated in Spain.
The Dadeland venue covers 3,543 square feet.

name: Under the Mango Tree
summary: Café on 5th Street.
facts: Relocated to Fifth Street from its earlier spot around the corner.
Its menu has featured organic peanut butter acai bowls, a spicy kale melt and juices.

name: Vapiano
summary: Italian restaurant.
facts: Pasta is cooked to order while diners watch.

name: Veganlitaly
summary: Restaurant on Southwest 8th Street, Coral Gables.
facts: A 100% vegan restaurant serving plant-based Italian food.
Also goes by the name ittle litaly.

name: Verde
summary: Restaurant.
facts: Located inside the Pérez Art Museum Miami.
Its seasonal menus draw inspiration from the museum's current exhibitions.

name: Vero italian
summary: Restaurant.

name: Versailles
summary: Café.
facts: Operates in Concourse D at Miami International Airport.

name: Versailles Bakery
summary: Bakery on Southwest 8th Street, Miami.
facts: Bakes Cuban pastries including guava and cream cheese pastelitos.
Also makes tres leches and key lime pie cakes.

name: Vice City Bean
summary: Café on North Miami Avenue.
facts: Founded by Roland and Eva Baker, a couple who moved to Miami from Los Angeles.
Located in the Filling Station Lofts building.
Its house coffee comes from Madcap Coffee of Grand Rapids, Michigan.
Address: 1657 unit c North Miami Avenue

name: Vicky Bakery
summary: Bakery.
facts: Part of Vicky Bakery, a chain founded by Cuban immigrants.

name: Vicky Cafe
summary: Bakery on Stanford Drive, Coral Gables.
facts: Brought Cuban food to the UM campus food court in 2017, replacing Innovation Kitchen.

name: Vicky's Bakery
summary: Bakery.
facts: Part of Vicky Bakery, founded in Hialeah in 1972 by Antonio and Gelasia Cao.
The chain is a family business that has grown to 30+ locations using the same family pastelito recipe.

name: Villa Italian Kitchen
summary: Italian restaurant.
facts: Located pre-security in Terminal G at Miami International Airport.

name: Vintage Auto Spa & Bistro Café
summary: Café on Southwest 17th Avenue, Miami.
facts: Operates as a car wash with an attached bistro cafe.

name: Wynwood Smoke and Lounge
summary: Middle Eastern restaurant on Northwest 24th Street, Miami.
facts: Also runs as a smoke shop alongside the lounge.
Address: 320 Northwest 24th Street, Unit b, Miami

name: XO Espresso Bar
summary: Café on Lincoln Lane North, Miami Beach.
facts: Located inside the Lincoln Eatery food hall.
Address: 723 Lincoln Lane North, Miami Beach

name: Xpress Food
summary: Grill restaurant on Pine Tree Drive, Miami Beach.
facts: Also listed for delivery under the name Xpress Food & Stuff.
Address: 2315 Pine Tree Drive, Miami Beach

name: Yalla Yalla Lebanese Kitchen
summary: Middle Eastern restaurant.

name: Yambo
summary: Nicaraguan restaurant.
facts: A Nicaraguan restaurant in the Little Havana neighborhood.

name: Yisell Bakery & Coffee
summary: Bakery.
facts: A bakery serving coffee and pastry in Little Havana.

name: Zucca
summary: Restaurant on Alcazar Avenue, Coral Gables.
facts: An Italian restaurant and bar inside the historic Hotel St. Michel.
Da Silva Hospitality Group celebrated the restaurant's grand opening.

name: Zuma
summary: Restaurant on Southeast 4th Street, Miami.
facts: The first U.S. location of Zuma, a restaurant that started in London.
Located in the Kimpton EPIC Hotel.

name: Lighthouse Cafe
summary: Restaurant on Crandon Boulevard.
facts: First opened in 1995 inside Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park.
Serves cafe fare, American dishes and seafood.
Looks out over the Atlantic Ocean.

name: Piononos
summary: Dessert shop on Crandon Blvd.
facts: Its pavlova layers sliced strawberries, dulce de leche and whipped cream on a walnut meringue.
Also makes the pionono, a sponge cake rolled around dulce de leche.
A takeaway bakery with no seating.

name: Artisan Kitchen & Bar
summary: Latin American restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Has an industrial look decorated with local artwork, with indoor and outdoor seating.
Serves Venezuelan tapas and hosts a Sunday brunch with live music.

name: Ayesha Saffron
summary: Indian restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Opened by the team that used to run Taste of Bombay in downtown Miami.
Serves Indian food built around tandoori cooking, with patio seating.
Part of a group that also runs Ayesha Fine Dining in Pinecrest and Saffron@Grove.

name: Bë Bakery
summary: Bakery on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Run by Mendoza, Argentina natives Elisa Cruz and Alejandra Príncipe.
The business began in Mendoza in 2010 as a catering company and opened its first bakery there in 2018.
The menu centers on medialunas, alfajores, savory sandwiches and coffee.
Took the place of the island bakery Clásica Victoria, which was sold and rebranded as Bë Bakery.

name: Brasas KB
summary: Peruvian restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: A Peruvian rotisserie whose signature is pollo a la brasa, served with sandwiches and salchipapas.
Its chicken comes with Peruvian sauces such as huancaína, ají amarillo and huacatay.

name: Casa Silva
summary: Spanish restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: A Spanish takeout and specialty food store run by Gabriela Silva, who is from Madrid.
Her father ran a similar business on the island about a decade before.
Sells Valenciana, fideuá and seafood paellas to go.
Offers wines from Spain, Argentina and Italy by the glass or bottle.

name: Ceviche Bar by Mixtura
summary: Peruvian restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Its menu includes Peruvian ceviches, causas and seafood plates.
Dogs can join their owners at its outdoor tables.

name: Costa Med
summary: Mediterranean restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Founded in 2003 by a Key Biscayne resident.
The kitchen blends Mediterranean, European, Caribbean, Asian and South American flavors.
Pairs its food with an international wine list and craft beers.

name: D'lite Bistro & Bakery
summary: Café on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: An all-day cafe that makes salmon bowls, acai bowls and gluten-free arepas.
The menu includes a Mediterranean bowl, a perico arepa and pan de bono.
Opened in 2020 by Colombian-born owner Alessandra Zurek.

name: Donut Gallery Diner
summary: Diner restaurant on Harbor Dr, Key Biscayne.
facts: Opened by Acela and Benjamin Zambrano, Cuban immigrants who moved to Miami in 1971.
Their son Nelson now runs the diner with his family.
Has served breakfast and lunch on Key Biscayne since 1972.
A narrow counter spot where low vinyl stools look over the griddle.

name: Flour & Weirdoughs
summary: Bakery on Harbor Dr, Key Biscayne.
facts: Bakes sourdough breads such as loaves stuffed with pork belly or made in the style of cacio e pepe.
Has a dining room next door for a sit-down breakfast or lunch.

name: FULANO
summary: Argentinian restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Calls itself Key Biscayne's neighborhood restaurant and serves Argentine food.
Has an indoor dining salon and an outdoor terrace with a rustic-modern look.

name: Kazumi
summary: Japanese restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: A contemporary Japanese restaurant run by chef Antonio Braschi.
Its dishes include a tuna pizza and truffle edamame.
Sits in the Square Shopping Center.

name: KeBo Restaurant
summary: Spanish restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Opened in January 2014 as a Spanish gastronomy project.
Its menu includes several paellas and a charcoal grill section.
Its turbot, branzino and octopus are cooked over a charcoal grill.

name: La Boulangerie Boul'Mich
summary: Bakery on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: The bakery's roots on Key Biscayne go back to 1998, when it began as La Nueva Boulangerie.
Venezuela-born partners led by Avy Cohen bought the brand from chef Massimo Stanzione in 2014.
The Key Biscayne shop is the original of a bakery group that later opened in Aventura, Pinecrest, Boca Raton and Doral.

name: La Scala
summary: Italian restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: An Italian bistro in the Arcade Shopping Center, which opened at this location in 2017.
The dining room has about a dozen tables.

name: Lima Estilo Nikkei
summary: Peruvian, japanese restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Opened by Argentine siblings María, Ramón and Santiago García Calvo.
The siblings started a Buenos Aires restaurant of the same name in 2019.
Serves Peruvian-Japanese Nikkei food such as truffled salmon belly nigiri and wasabi ceviche.

name: Luma
summary: Italian restaurant on Grand Bay Dr, Key Biscayne.
facts: The Italian restaurant of The Ritz-Carlton Key Biscayne, with indoor and outdoor oceanfront dining.
Its name means brightness in Italian.
Address: 455 Grand Bay Dr, Key Biscayne

name: Milanezza
summary: Argentinian restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Serves Argentinian dishes with a twist in a casual room with a vintage feel.
The menu offers more than 18 combinations of its namesake milanesa.
Owners Gladys Arneri and Max Waicman opened their first restaurant here after moving from Buenos Aires.

name: Nahuen Gourmet Market
summary: Café on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: An Argentinean gourmet market, listed earlier as Patagonia Nahuen.
Sells homemade baked goods, deli items and made-to-order sandwiches.
Serves Argentinian dishes, desserts, medialunas and espresso drinks.

name: Papercrane Asian Bistro
summary: Thai, sushi restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Known as Origin until a rebrand, it spent nearly two decades at Key Colony Plaza.
Moved to the Galleria Shopping Center, keeping its menu and staff.
Serves Thai noodle dishes and sushi rolls.

name: Paralía
summary: Greek restaurant on Grand Bay Dr, Key Biscayne.
facts: An open-air beachfront restaurant at The Ritz-Carlton Key Biscayne, drawing on Greek and Turkish tavernas.
Its drinks list features Greek wines, ouzo and cocktails made with local botanicals.
Chef John Iatrellis, who helped open Claudie in Miami, now runs its kitchen.
Address: 455 Grand Bay Dr, Key Biscayne

name: SALT Waterfront Restaurant
summary: American restaurant on Rickenbacker Causeway, Miami.
facts: Sits on the University of Miami's Rosenstiel School campus and is open to the public.
Its menu covers seafood and sandwiches, with vegetarian and vegan options.

name: Sir Pizza
summary: Pizza restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Began on Key Biscayne as a Pizza King and was renamed Sir Pizza in 1969.
Now owned by Barry, the son of its founder.
For a long time it was one of just a few restaurants on the island.
Known for square-cut pizzas, it grew to 11 more locations in Miami-Dade and Broward.

name: The Empanada's
summary: Argentinian restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Founded by Mariana Schron of Buenos Aires and her husband, Santiago Pinera.
This is the original shop, opened in 2019; the brand later expanded across Miami-Dade and Broward.
Makes more than 25 flavors of Argentinean empanadas.

name: The Golden Hog
summary: Deli restaurant on Harbor Dr, Key Biscayne.
facts: A neighborhood food market that has operated on the island since 1995.
Stocks imported goods such as Échiré butter from France and Petrossian caviar.
Serves deli sandwiches, churrasco from the grill and cappuccino at its bakery counter.

name: The Spruce Juice
summary: Café on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: Presses its raw juices and blends smoothies and acai bowls such as the Nutty bowl.
Opened in the Key Colony Shopping Center and became an after-school stop for island students.

name: Tutto Pizza & Pasta
summary: Italian restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: A family-friendly Italian trattoria with indoor seating and an outdoor patio.
Its menu includes filet mignon carpaccio, burrata and meatballs parmigiana.

name: Vinya
summary: Restaurant on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: A wine bar and shop: guests pick a bottle from the shelves to drink on site.
The kitchen serves more than 25 dishes drawing on European technique and Latin flavors.
Took over and renovated Stefano's, a Key Biscayne fixture since 1980.
Co-owned by sommelier Allegra Angelo, whose Coral Gables sister restaurant Vinya Table closed in late 2025.

name: Yogurt By U
summary: Ice cream shop on Crandon Blvd, Key Biscayne.
facts: A frozen yogurt shop with a wide range of flavors and toppings.
Islander News lists it as a casual, kid-friendly frozen yogurt stop.
